newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo bourse applies to list Sangetsu on Dec 6.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo bourse applies to list Sangetsu on Dec 6.

text.p: The Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) said on Friday that it had applied to the Ministry of Finance (MOF) to list shares of Sangetsu Co Ltd on December 6.
Sangetsu, a retailer specialising in sales of wallpaper, curtains and flooring material, is aiming for a listing on the first section of the exchange, the TSE said.

The firm, currently listed on the Nagoya bourse, will offer 1.2 million new shares when it lists on the TSE and 1.0 million existing shares will also be offered, the exchange said in a statement. The payment date is December 5.
